question_text: Distinguish RAM from ROM in terms of power loss and ordinary modification of stored data.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: RAM is volatile and permits normal reads/writes during processing. ROM is nonvolatile and is normally read during operation rather than modified by ordinary program writes.

marking_points.criterion: RAM ordinary read/write versus ROM normally read-only.
